title: Choose a delivery format
brief: A small example of one decision with three coherent outcomes.
content:
## Delivery

::passage{id="delivery"}

:::when{parameter="format" equals="web"}
### Hosting

Publish the site over HTTPS. Verify the layout on a phone and a desktop.
:::

:::when{parameter="format" equals="pdf"}
### Print layout

Check page breaks and embedded fonts before exporting.
:::

:::when{parameter="format" equals="markdown"}
### Portability

Use relative image paths and standard Markdown so another renderer can display the document.
:::

previews.web: A responsive page that can be shared with a link.
previews.pdf: A paginated file ready for printing.
previews.markdown: A portable text file ready for another tool.

cases.content: Deliver [a website](input:format). Build a responsive reading page with a shareable URL.
Deliver [a PDF](input:format). Produce a paginated document that can be downloaded and printed.
Deliver [a Markdown document](input:format). Export the text and its local assets for use in other tools.
